programme.title: 深海大探險 -模糊地帶
programme.desc: Kaiko and Will try to examine a glowing fish but fall under its spell. Ant and Fontaine must rescue their parents, wearing blindfolds.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -色彩爆好玩
programme.desc: Eric learns that if you want to create different paint colours, all you have to do is mix your paints. As long as you have the primary colours – red, blue, and yellow – you can create lots of new shades.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -駭走你的心
programme.desc: Robbie and Flippy have been messing with the affections of a nerd they met online, pretending to be a girl to make fun of him. But the nerd is a professional hacker, and the tables are turned..

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -韓德森老師的男朋友
programme.desc: Ms Henderson is in love and life is easy for the kids. When she breaks up and turns her anger on them, they come up with a complicated plan to reboot her love life.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -宮廷愛情
programme.desc: Dove is going through a rocky time with her horrible husband, Lord Roach. She consequently falls for Sir Howler. Despite being humble and loyal, Howler isn't always a paragon of finesse when it comes to winning the lady's heart or dealing with the jealous spouse.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -解決汙染問題
programme.desc: When an oil spill happens out at sea, the kids come up with a plan to save the sea animals of Kiwifruit Valley.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -綿羊理髮院
programme.desc: When a friendly sheep turns up in Kiwifruit Valley, Darwin and Newts have to figure out what to do about her very woolly coat.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -強大的肌肉
programme.desc: One of Britain's strongest women, Andrea Thompson, joins the Doctors in the lab as they reveal how muscle fibers work, and we welcome three more incredible Ouch! Award finalists.

programme.desc: Eric is fooled by an optical illusion with three lines. Then he draws a goldfish and a bowl and sticks them to a pencil to create his own optical illusion.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -電磁鐵吸引力
programme.desc: Eric learns how to make an electromagnet using a nail, a battery and some electrical wire. The electricity passing through the wire creates an invisible force called a magnetic field, making the nail work like a magnet. He uses it to pick up paper clips from the table.

programme.title: 那天亨利遇到... -那天亨利遇到...熊
programme.desc: Henry meets a Bear in the woods. He becomes a Park Ranger and reads Bear a bedtime story to help him get sleepy for hibernation.

programme.title: 那天亨利遇到... -那天亨利遇到...垃圾桶
programme.desc: Henry meets Dustbin, Recycle Bin and Compost Bin. Henry becomes a Waste Collector and puts all the rubbish in his Dustbin Lorry.

programme.title: 那天亨利遇到... -那天亨利遇到...聖誕樹
programme.desc: Henry meets a Fir Tree, and he becomse a Christmas Elf to help Fir Tree fulfill his dream of becoming a decorated Christmas Tree.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -顯微的啟示
programme.desc: How long is our DNA? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of microbiology. Have hands-on fun by extracting DNA from a strawberry, and get to know V. Narry Kim, a microbiologist, known for her work with micro RNA in regulating our gene expression.

programme.title: 南瓜報告 -害麥斯被禁足
programme.desc: When Max is entrusted with a valuable crystal trophy, Teresa plots to get him grounded for life by smashing it to pieces while it's in his possession.

programme.title: 動物電視台 -松貂
programme.desc: After learning that pine martens eat squirrels, Red and Grey panic as they wonder how safe their treehouse is. Inspired by the beauty of the pine marten, Fiona Fox decides to give Orla and Meabh new hairstyles.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -旋轉藝術器
programme.desc: Rotate to create with this crafty contraption.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -遊戲開始
programme.desc: Sometimes Gabi takes winning way too seriously. Doki wonders - does Gabi really have to win, to have fun? To find out, they set off to the ‘One of a Kind Game Kingdom' at the Silly Sports Park in Japan, where the games are as goofy as they are unique.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -火星探險
programme.desc: Can we really go to Mars? The team blasts off, and before you know it, they're exploring Mars while Fico and Oto go looking for the lander. But the two are stunned to see a space-suited Martian take the lander inside his house.

programme.title: 破紀錄的那件事 -凱文博奎斯特: 格鬥術冠軍
programme.desc: Karate champion and GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS holder Kevin Bergquist meets with Will Munford and shares the fundamentals of staying positive and focused. Kevin also teaches Will about confidence and how to use that to his advantage.

programme.title: 破紀錄的那件事 -碧安卡喬奇爾蘭: 懸浮滑板表演者
programme.desc: Young hoverboard artist Bianca Ciocirlan shares how she became the best in the world, achieving forty-five pirouettes on a hoverboard in thirty seconds. Bianca is also a professional hoverboard performer and former figure skater.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 外太空 -太空迷航
programme.desc: There have been a few occasions when spacecraft have been lost in space. Host Emily Calandrelli looks at several of these adventures. In some cases, the spacecraft that were lost, were remarkably found again.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 外太空 -加拿大太空總署
programme.desc: Canada has made significant contributions to the space effort, despite having a much smaller budget than NASA. Host Emily Calandrelli visits the Canadian Space Center in Quebec, and examines their exceptional expertise in robotics, which includes the famous Canadarm.

programme.desc: Eric learns how to make an electromagnet using a nail, a battery and some electrical wire. The electricity passing through the wire creates an invisible force called a magnetic field, making the nail work like a magnet. He uses it to pick up paper clips from the table.

programme.title: 體操新星 -回憶的意義
programme.desc: The Rhythmic squad is training hard for the competition. But a disaster strikes when one of the team gets injured. And things aren't going so well for trampoline gymnast Corey either.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -魔術師與隊長
programme.desc: In this episode of Becoming Xtraordinary presented by Bear Grylls, the 'Undisputed King of Magic' Steven Frayne (aka Dynamo) and Olympic gold medallist hockey captain Kate Richardson-Walsh share their insights on success.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -打氣機的時代
programme.desc: Eric makes a rocket from a plastic bottle and some cardboard. Then he uses an air pump to cause a transfer of energy that is strong enough to launch the rocket into the sky.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -宴會時間
programme.desc: As the ice skating season draws to a close, there is the annual event in the calendar that everyone is talking about. All the Ice Stars gather together for some sensational Hollywood-themed performances. For the Icicles, it's the last time they'll skate together.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -刺激的聲音
programme.desc: Eric learns how sound waves work in the air and in water. Then he does an experiment to make sound waves travel along a piece of string.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -解開謎團
programme.desc: The cute homeless dogs are looking for new owners, and Johnny and Inel solve the mysteries of goats that climb trees and dogs with unusual toilet habits! The Junior Vets are trying to figure out how to give a big brown bear its medicine.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -烏龜
programme.desc: The Nektons explore a floating island and find the pieces of the ancient Lemurian navigation device. But why is this island moving.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -我們是超級英雄
programme.desc: It's superhero time as the doctors' alter-egos go into battle to show the secret powers of your skin, which uses Vitamin D from the sun to make your bones strong! And Dr. Raph is on duty for incredible eye surgery.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -星星之力
programme.desc: In this episode, we use the kirigami method to make our own pentagram: the 5-pointed star famous for being a magical symbol. If Eric can do it, you can do it, too! It's not magic ... it's math.

programme.title: 體操新星 -近在咫尺
programme.desc: Amelie spends precious time with her family, while the Acrobatic gymnasts have a crucial competition and will have a chance to win a place at the World Championships in Belgium.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -露比的臭腳
programme.desc: The Junior Vets are on the farm, hoping to discover some pregnant cows. Poor Fern, the lurcher, has been abandoned and needs a new home. Ruby, the lamb, has a smelly infected foot, and Johnny and Inel meet a dog who likes to join the family for dinner.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -我有七隻腳那麼高
programme.desc: Did you know that most of us are seven feet tall? Seven of our own feet, that is. This episode shows how indirect measures can be used to establish relatively accurate estimates of body part dimensions. Are you seven feet tall, too.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -來抓我
programme.desc: Today, the Junior Vets meet some feisty meerkats who need their claws trimmed, but first, they've got to catch them. Ashanti, the elephant, gets his feet and tail cleaned. Johnny and Inel discover what you get when you cross a lion and a tiger.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -骰子戲法
programme.desc: In this episode Eric presents an amazing dice trick: Just by looking at a tower of any number of dice, he can accurately calculate the sum of the hidden faces. How does he do it? And, is it magic ... or is it math?

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -乾涸的鳥池
programme.desc: Kea's bird bath keeps running out of water, and after investigating the problem, Darwin and Newts discover that it's evaporating in the sun.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -刺激的雲霄飛車
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts build their own roller-coaster and learn how trains stay on track and how you can loop the loop.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -折射上的反射
programme.desc: Eric does a fun experiment to show how refraction plays tricks with our eyes. He learns that when we look at objects, we see the light reflected from them. Because light doesn't travel as well through water as it does through air, things in water look different to us.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -貓熊與金剛鸚鵡

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -秘密訊息
programme.desc: Eric learns that, with a little science, you can bring out all the colours that make up the black ink in felt tip markers. He separates the colours using chromatography. This gives him a way to write secret messages.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -虎鯨寶寶
programme.desc: Morgan, the deaf orca, is about to give birth to her very first calf. The stakes are high, and the staff at Loro Parque are holding their collective breath as the scene is set for the greatest natural phenomenon in the zoo's history.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -熱的顏色
programme.desc: Eric learns that wearing light colours in the sun keeps you cooler than dark colours. He does an ice cube experiment to how lighter colours reflect light and heat, just like a mirror.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -艾瑞克的熊爪
programme.desc: Eric learns that many animals have developed an insulating coat of fat to keep them warm and dry. He uses this idea to create a way to put his hand in very cold water without getting hurt.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -征服世界
programme.desc: Josh is in Hungary, representing Great Britain in his first-ever World Championships. Back home, Jellie has a big decision to make, and Kloe is disappointed not to be in Hungary.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -宴會日
programme.desc: It is Gala day, and the theme is the Frozen Kingdom. The Ice Stars gather together for what promises to be a sensational performance. But as the skaters are getting ready, some shattering news breaks at the rink.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -水陸交界
programme.desc: Four young adventurers head to West Coast National Park in South Africa and discover a world of seabirds and snakes. Along the way they go canoeing and snorkelling, meet wild animals and learn the value of nature parks.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -沿岸沙漠
programme.desc: Four young adventurers explore Namaqua National Park in South Africa, a desert region with the largest concentration of succulent plants in the world. They learn how to survive in its harsh environment by learning ancient traditions.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -國王企鵝
programme.desc: Annabelle, the king penguin, is displaying some worrying symptoms. She's waving her head about skywards and Jorge is concerned she may have some neurological problems. Will Annabelle rejoin her friends on the great, icy mound at Loro Parque ever again.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -烏龜菲德莉卡
programme.desc: Federica, the turtle, has arrived from Italy after a run-in with a container ship. Loro Parque has offered to be her ‘forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? Esmeralda, the iguana, has a lumpy belly and Jorge, the vet, is worried.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -厄瓜多之旅
programme.desc: Zoe's avocado tree is not in good shape, and she doesn't know how to revive it. Our friends travel to Ecuador, where they meet Idzi. He has a fabulous garden and a particular way to tend it.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -日本之旅, 第一部
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo do not seem to know that there is a place on Earth where it is not at all polite to open a present in front of the person that gave it to you. Alim suggests bringing his friends to Japan, where they meet Kimiko.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -摩洛哥之旅
programme.desc: Zoe is disgusted when she sees that Alim starts eating the chocolate mousse she prepared without a spoon. Soon after, they travel to Morocco and learn more about the eating customs there.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -奈及利亞之旅
programme.desc: Alim thinks that the criteria for being beautiful are not the same from country to country. To prove that beauty standards vary across cultures, he takes his friends to Nigeria, where, as they speak, a beauty contest is taking place.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -飛碟
programme.desc: Robbie and Naomi are abducted by inquisitive aliens while in the park, and the other kids have to figure out a way to rescue them from the hovering spacecraft.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -極佳的溶解度
programme.desc: Eric is not sure what soluble means. To find out, he makes a snow globe and compares things that are soluble in water with things that are not.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -解決汙染問題
programme.desc: When an oil spill happens out at sea, the kids come up with a plan to save the sea animals of Kiwifruit Valley.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -綿羊理髮院
programme.desc: When a friendly sheep turns up in Kiwifruit Valley, Darwin and Newts have to figure out what to do about her very woolly coat.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -迷人的化石
programme.desc: Were all dinosaurs reptiles? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of palaeontology. Have hands-on fun by creating a dinosaur egg, and get to know Teuku Jacob, who used fossils and remains to study the origins and predecessors of present human species.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -點亮太陽系
programme.desc: What's the best way to remember the colours of the rainbow? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of light in space. Have hands-on fun by creating a kaleidoscope, and get to know Wang Zhenyi, who originated her own exact model of the solar system.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -幽靈卡丁車之謎
programme.desc: When Kevin's new radio-controlled model car starts acting like it has a bad-tempered mind of its own, he becomes convinced that it is haunted and asks Addison to help.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -破掉的氣球之謎
programme.desc: When helium balloons for Tess's fashion show start inexplicably popping, she is upset and asks Addison to help her figure out the cause and stop the rest of the balloons from popping before her show is RUINED!

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -日本巨無霸
programme.desc: Doki decides to go to the Ogasawara Islands, Japan, to make his own deep sea nature video, and get footage of the rare and elusive giant squid! How hard could it be? The team learns that you have to practice and prepare before taking on big challenges.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -會飛的魚
programme.desc: Anabella creates a giant fish sculpture. Could Anabella's kooky fish really fly? She is sure it can but flying experts Oto and Mundi have their doubts. They head to a ‘birdman' competition in California, USA to try to turn the crazy creation into a flying machine.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -T恤
programme.desc: Upcycling old t-shirts to a whole new level, let's just say we make them even more cooler.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -水桶
programme.desc: No place to sit? Do not worry, we have the most creative solution for you.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -拉法的一天
programme.desc: Meet the Loro Parque Foundation Scientific Director - Rafa, also known as the ‘Birdman of Loro Parque'. He wears the badge with pride and every day he surrounds himself with all things ornithological - from parrots and puffins to penguins.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -大猩猩醫腳
programme.desc: Ubongo, the gorilla, has a massive cut on his foot. But how do you treat a 400-pound gorilla with a sore foot? And have you ever seen a sloth take a shower? Hugo, the sloth, will draw back the shower curtain and reveal all.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -維京人
programme.desc: Like Raven and Little Lewis, the famous giants of the northern mists, the Vikings, are master looters and navigators. Besides being bloody warriors and shrewd negotiators, the Vikings are also great explorers, out to discover the world.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -弄臣
programme.desc: Lord Roach is feeling really down! His wife Geraldine goes out of her way to entertain him, bringing in acrobats, musicians, etc. But it's no good. Enter Little Lewis, dressed in his court jester costume and Lord Roach is very happy.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -香料熱潮
programme.desc: Spices are a hot item in the Middle Ages! Lord Roach just can't get enough of the stuff! If you can't find the spice you want at the local market stall, it's probably on the other side of the world! And so off goes Little Lewis.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -資源回收大盜
programme.desc: Addison and her friends are distracted from their mission of making cool costumes for Ayrton Park's version of Comicon when someone or something starts messing with recycling bins all over the neighbourhood.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -失蹤的無齒翼龍之謎
programme.desc: When an inflatable Pteranodon goes missing from the roof of Pizzamat, Addison and Alex are on the case to find it.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -桌布
programme.desc: Let's turn the tablecloth into something festive.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -錄音帶
programme.desc: Oo we have found some old gems, let's create something cool and funky out of them.

programme.title: 優可 -龍
programme.desc: While playing knights, the three friends start arguing because no one wants to be the baddie. They convince Ranger Loops to be the baddie, and the three knights embark on a mission to free Dragon-Yoko from the slide tower where he is being held captive.

programme.title: 藝術忍者 -寶寶日
programme.desc: Ricky is looking after his baby niece and has to use his skills to keep her amused. While left holding the baby, Ricky makes a cute critter toy and some epic art out of toilet rolls.

programme.title: 藝術忍者 -樂團日
programme.desc: Ricky decides to form a band, but the instruments he orders don't quite fit the bill. That doesn't stop Ricky from making musically-themed art, including a paper cup boom box and a guitarist sculpture inspired by Giacometti.

programme.title: 探討有趣新發明 -豪華樹屋
programme.desc: Host Alie Ward presents an inventor building mansions in trees, fingertip lighting, a book that filters water and a penguin chick bot that is giving researchers a new perspective on the penguin world.

programme.title: 探討有趣新發明 -內陸衝浪公園
programme.desc: Host Alie Ward presents an innovative Surf Park in North Wales, pet tech for cats and dogs, the engineering wizardry in massage chairs and the vertical gardens making Mexico's highways greener.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -神祕的白色珊瑚
programme.desc: The lab of Australian scientists inspecting the cause of the devastating coral reef bleaching epidemic has suffered a series of late-night robberies. And this is seriously interfering with their research.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -儒艮求救
programme.desc: A biologist has reported that many of Thailand's highly endangered dugongs are sick and haven't eaten for days. The fear is that something has tainted their natural food supply! The MeteoHeroes are going on a mission to save the poor dugongs.

programme.title: 地球小尖兵 -海洋生物學家
programme.desc: Kids meet a marine biologist.

programme.title: 打造貓樂園 -貓計程車
programme.desc: OEistein makes a cardboard cat taxi.

programme.title: 全球探險家霍吉 -霍吉去峇里省
programme.desc: Hogie and his pals run into trouble in Bali when an accident leaves them without a kite before the kite flying competition on the beach. Their new friend Made offers to help, and the friends set out to build their very own flying kite.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -豌豆公主的孫女
programme.desc: Rose, Hawk, Astoria, Travis, and Joy meet Bea, the granddaughter of the Princess and the Pea. Bea, sweet but strict, threatens to fail everyone. Rose realizes Bea's grouchiness is due to poor sleep, leading the team on a quest to find her a more comfortable bed.

programme.title: 神奇小百科 -蜜蜂是色盲嗎
programme.desc: Despite having five eyes, bees can't see red. They can, however, see ultraviolet, which is invisible to us. Flowers that look plain to us can look spectacular to a bee, with markings that we can't see guiding it to the tasty nectar.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -搜尋非洲七雄, 第2部: 大傢伙
programme.desc: A group of young adventurers continue their search for the Big Seven wild animals in Addo Elephant National Park in South Africa. They discover ancient rock art in caves and experience exciting moments with a large herd of elephants.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -搜尋非洲七雄, 第3部: 鯨喜時光
programme.desc: A group of young explorers head for the sea on their search for the biggest of the Big Seven wild animals in South Africa – the whale. On the way they meet giant snails, noisy frogs and dolphins. They are about to give up their search when they spot two playful whales.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -島民的寶藏
programme.desc: After Dolos has sold two maps to the same treasure, the pirates and the Nektons are racing to get to the treasure first.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -隧道
programme.desc: An undersea waterfall hides a mysterious tunnel behind it. As the Nektons explore it, they find not everything is as it should be.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -大教堂
programme.desc: If you want a cathedral, you'd better not be in a hurry! The construction site is a village in its own right, and lasts for several generations! Foreman Howler shows us round a medieval construction site, providing us with a 101 on cathedral-building techniques.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -司法與正義
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, safety's a little shaky. So is justice! It's ‘Sheriff' Howler's job to hunt down outlaws and bring them before the judge. But the methods he uses are a trifle different from what we're used to today.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -鬼魂
programme.desc: Robbie and Flippy fall out over some fireworks Robbie has bought. With Robbie covered in white powder from an accidental explosion, and Flippy pretending he doesn't exist, Albert is convinced Robbie is a ghost that only he can see.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -菲利浦的鞋
programme.desc: Robbie and Flippy get into some serious rivalry over who's better at basketball and organise a showdown. Flippy's new trainers turn out to have powers that give him the edge; he looks certain to win, until it all goes wrong.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -奇怪的審判
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, animals are considered responsible for their actions and must answer to their crimes in a court of law! A crazy trial takes place, with Howler as the animals' attorney and Roach as the judge and persecutor.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -探索工程
programme.desc: How do simple building elements create architecture? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of construction. Have hands-on fun by building your own tower, and get to know Fazlur Rahman Khan, who came up with the ‘tube' structure in skyscraper design.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -天啊!天文學
programme.desc: How do rockets manage to defy gravity? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of astronomy. Have hands-on fun by launching your own rocket, and get to know Edwin Hubble, an astronomer, who proved the universe consists of entire galaxies and is expanding.

programme.title: 優可 -我的工藝品
programme.desc: Yoko gives the kids a magic spade that makes giant sandcastles! But when Oto builds too quickly, he learns the value of taking his time.

programme.title: 優可 -故事書的結局
programme.desc: When Vik reads a storybook to his friends, Yoko adds some magic that allows the kids to create new parts of the tale.

programme.title: 和格林韋德一家環保生活 -重複利用製作之秘密基地
programme.desc: Daddy is vacuuming and the children can't play around. Luckily, Harper decides to reuse old bedsheets, hang them over some chairs and make a den. Inside and outside, the children have found it is simple to create a den and make a space to play.

programme.title: 和格林韋德一家環保生活 -降低螢幕使用時間
programme.desc: The Grimwades decide to reduce screen time by taking a screen break. With their devices stored away in a cardboard box, they go to a sensory garden and experience the here and now by using each of their five senses one by one.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -風帆車
programme.desc: How do you make a wind powered wonder wagon? You'll need a paper cup and the power of puff.

programme.title: 優可 -完美的野餐
programme.desc: When the kids can't agree on a perfect picnic location, they learn that compromise is important so everyone can have fun.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -飛天豬
programme.desc: My oh my... it's a pig in the sky! We'll show you how to make this little piggy go “weeeeeeee!

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -泰國之旅
programme.desc: Is there a country where even toddlers happily eat the spiciest dishes? Our heroes travel to Thailand to find out. And Alim's penfriend Narawan prepares a spicy meal.

programme.title: 小小致富夢想家 -28件雜事之後
programme.desc: When Max becomes obsessed with his new reality game that involves killing zombies while performing household tasks, Noodles takes the lead and pursues his own idea.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -腸道大放送
programme.desc: Dr. Xand swallows a camera pill to show the incredible villi inside his intestines which absorb the nutrients from food. There's a mind-boosting tip to help in keeping positive, and the Ouchologists are back with more tough medical questions.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -白努利和同伴
programme.desc: Eric learns how the Bernoulli Principle and playing with the flow of air can help him inflate a plastic bag. This same principle explains how airplanes fly, too.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -快速的酵素
programme.desc: The doctors reveal how enzymes speed up chemical reactions inside the body with a foam experiment, and Dr. Xand explores how the brain reacts to music. Meanwhile, Alfie has a sore hip, and Taya has stepped on broken glass.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -三、二、一...升空
programme.desc: The chemical reaction that takes place in the engines of a real rocket produces a large amount of very hot gas that makes the rocket lift off into the sky. Eric mixes baking powder and water to create a chemical reaction strong enough to launch a toy rocket.

programme.title: 體操新星 -回憶的意義
programme.desc: The Rhythmic squad is training hard for the competition. But a disaster strikes when one of the team gets injured. And things aren't going so well for trampoline gymnast Corey either.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -健康檢查
programme.desc: Jamie and Nyatepe are helping vet Scott examine poorly dog Isla. Josh and Molly visit a newborn donkey. And alpacas are keeping Robyn and Bonte on their toes.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -超級形狀
programme.desc: Eric learns why the triangle is such an important shape for building. He builds a bridge made of straws that is so strong that he can balance several books on it.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -驚人的神經元
programme.desc: Eric learns that neurons are the brain's tiny building blocks. He does an experiment to show what they are and how they work. He is surprised to learn that giraffes have neurons that are five metres long.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -守門員與探險家
programme.desc: In this episode of Becoming Xtraordinary presented by Bear Grylls, the world's best field hockey goalkeeper and Olympic gold medallist, Maddie Hinch, and the world's greatest living explorer, Ranulph Fiennes, share their record breaking journeys.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -求生者與老闆
programme.desc: In this episode of Becoming Xtraordinary, Bear Grylls shares his story of perseverance and how he became 'the world's best known survival expert', while Ursula Burns reflects on her journey to becoming the first Black woman CEO of a Fortune 500 company.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -孤注一擲
programme.desc: It's a busy week for our Ice Stars. Charlie and Freddie have tryouts for a different sort of ice sport. Meanwhile, the Icicles are taking a break from their busy schedule and having some fun off the ice. And Asiyah is waiting for an important call.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -令人欽佩的水中上將
programme.desc: Eric learns that even if something is made from a material that is denser or heavier than water, it will float if it has the right shape. He makes a paper boat strong enough to carry toy cars without sinking.

programme.title: 寵物救援隊 -忙碌的一天
programme.desc: Foster carer Geoff is grappling with Turbo's penchant for pooping in the bath. Xavier sets a trap for a stray cat that has been hunting native wildlife. And Marisa helps a sick mum feed her kittens.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -如果鞋子合腳..
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how many ways a shoelace can be tied? Four ways? Six ways? No, 43,000 ways! In this episode we learn everything there is to know about different types of patterning: over and under, left and right, in and out, zigzag and crisscross, etc.

programme.title: 神秘大探索: 科學DIY -液體
programme.desc: In this episode host Steve Spangler shows how to walk on water and does other unbelievable experiments you can do at home. They all explore the question: What is a fluid.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室: 請在家嘗試 -蛋味牙齒
programme.desc: In this episode, the doctors chew disclosing tablets to take a close look at their gnashers - who will have brushed their teeth the best?! And find out what happens to your teeth when you eat and drink with an eggs-cellent experiment.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室: 請在家嘗試 -膝蓋骨挑戰
programme.desc: There's chaos in the kitchen lab as Baby LiLou joins the doctors to reveal why you need kneecaps. Find out how your knees work with a simple Do Try experiment.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -注意音符的分數
programme.desc: How can distinct sounds be formed? In this episode we learn about the key role that fractions play in denoting whole, half, and quarter notes. Can Eric compose his own cool song using nothing but fractions.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -神秘的多重艾瑞克
programme.desc: Have you ever noticed that as you reduce the angle between two mirrors, you will see an ever-increasing number of objects? If the mirrors are parallel to each other, can we see infinity? Eric travels to another dimension to find out.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -這個搭配那個跟那個
programme.desc: How many different looks can you create with six shirts and four pair of pants? In this episode we're introduced to the mathematical concepts ‘possibilities' and ‘combinations'. How can they help us solve the riddle.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -放屁火箭
programme.desc: Could farts power a rocket? And Gladiator Dynamite tests Dr Dan and Dr Raph's dunking skills in an epic Body Battle.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -摺摺紙, 跳跳蛙
programme.desc: Can you turn a two-dimensional sheet of paper into a three-dimensional hopping frog? In this episode we explain the geometry behind paper folding and teach you how to create your own 3D aquarium! Crock, crock.

programme.title: 體操新星 -更上一層樓
programme.desc: Abi, Gabby, and Shams get a surprise visit! Young artistic gymnast Chase is off to the South West competition, and acro gymnast Izzy is worried as she's been called into the hospital for a scan on her knee as her injury isn't healing.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -獸醫值班中
programme.desc: The Junior Vets check out some lovely lemurs, get up close with Fluffy, the python, and meet a vulture called Derek! Plus, some cute little piglets need help, and Johnny and Inel meet a singing dog.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -丹麥大象
programme.desc: This episode demonstrates how following a specific sequence of arithmetic steps, combined with the special properties of number 9, will always result in the same answer. Amaze your friends with your mind-reading super skills.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -潑辣的獾
programme.desc: Today Matilda, the horse, has surgery, and a cute but feisty badger needs help after being hit by a car. The Junior Vets release Timbuktu, the hedgehog, back into the wild, and Johnny and Inel find out how fish sleep and meet a dog with a passion for pop music.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -三角形的不同邊
programme.desc: Eric tests the strength of a paper chair. Will it buckle under pressure or will it stand up to the test? Triangles are inherently strong because they form a fixed shape that's been used in architecture throughout the ages, but are they really the strongest shape ever.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -瓦比第的輪椅武士獨木舟
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts are preparing their waka for summer, but when Wapiti turns up in a wheelchair, they have to find a way to make the waka more accessible.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -奇異果山谷聖誕節
programme.desc: When a Christmas Eve storm wrecks the festive preparations of our harried squabbling team they remember how important their friendship is and work together to create a Christmas celebration that may not be perfect but is full of aroha.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -膨脹
programme.desc: Eric learns that yeast is used to make bread rise and that it produces gases when it feeds on sugar. He does an experiment with a balloon to show how this works.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -佐治的一天
programme.desc: As Loro Parque's head vet, Jorge never knows from one day to the next what will come through his clinic. Javier, Loro Parque's Head of Environmental Affairs, is hitting the high seas of Tenerife with a turtle tracker in hand to help with scientific research.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -瓶中的星星
programme.desc: Eric learns constellations are groups of stars and that they often have shapes that look like animals, objects, or even people. He makes a lantern that can project the constellation Ursa Major, also known as the Great Bear because it looks like a big bear in the sky.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -小丑魚與白虎
programme.desc: We follow the aquarium team as they initiate their very own breeding program with the hope of finding many more clownfish to come. In the meantime, Lin Mao, the white tiger, has something wrong with his hip and the vets need to make a diagnosis.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -酥脆的水晶
programme.desc: Eric learns that although it can take millions of years to make one crystal, he can make some in just a week with an easy experiment. His new crystals taste good, too.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -往上流的水
programme.desc: Eric does a magic trick that defies the laws of gravity. Then he learns how to make water flow upwards using a science experiment involving flowers and capillary action.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -嶄新開始
programme.desc: Figure skaters Josh and Kloe must pull out all the stops to impress a royal visitor. There is also another very special person making a return to the rink, and ice dancer Ella has just days to get herself ready for her first-ever solo performance.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -重新上路

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -奶油妙招

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -蜂窩危機
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts follow a bee to learn why it is visiting flowers, and when the hive gets disturbed, they build a new beehive for Heni's garden.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -噴射高空滑索

programme.title: 科學量販店 -元素週期表

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -萬聖節鬧鬼之謎
programme.desc: Addison and Tess make a haunted maze for Halloween, but things take a perplexing turn when it seems that there really is a spooky presence on the loose within it – scaring away all their customers.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -逃跑的機器人之謎

programme.desc: When the team's high-tech dance party is threatened by a power outage, they're frustrated and fly off to find a place where things are still normal. Mistakenly, they end up at a historic village, where they live like it's 150 years ago.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -多奇探險隊的果汁之旅
programme.desc: When the team wants a new water slide for the clubhouse beach, they decide to fund it by selling Anabella's delicious lemonade. But the slide costs a lot, and they want it fast! So how can they sell as much lemonade as possible? They split into two teams.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -地球日
programme.desc: Let's celebrate this wonderful planet we call home! Make sure to remember our 3 Rs.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -麵粉
programme.desc: Ahh something smells so good, what is it? Oh it's Hepi and Briko's fresh new ideas! What are they up to now.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -海豚

programme.title: 動物大使館 -艾斯特的一天

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -中世紀家庭生活
programme.desc: Meet a peasant family in their daily lives, back in the Middle Ages. Dove and Howler are very busy parents! Besides educating their little urchin kids, welcoming a new baby, dealing with daily home life, life for these peasant parents is eventful to say the least.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -建造堅固的城堡
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, castles are built to protect their residents from danger. Lord Roach wants to have his castle fitted with every single type of defense system. Howle r- his architect, loves the idea. But there is something that may ruin the construction process.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -神祕失蹤的小貓案件
programme.desc: When Mr. Tiggles goes missing, Addison must figure out if this is just a matter of a cat stuck in a tree, or a nefarious kitty kidnapping conspiracy.

programme.desc: Amazing idea after other, that's how it goes with these Dominos.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -緞帶

programme.title: 優可 -瓦瓦湖的怪獸

programme.desc: Doki can't stand when he doesn't know something. So when Gabi becomes extra secretive about her diary, he's determined to find out why. The Team learns about spy techniques and ways to uncover secrets that others don't want you to know.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -親身的獸醫體驗
programme.desc: Sam is due to operate on Stella, the dog after she got injured in a car crash. But is he ready to take part in urgent surgery? Plus, the Junior Vets join the emergency response team at the races and help heal hurt hooves down on the Vet School farm.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -照亮天際
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts build solar-powered lights to help them feed an injured kiwi in the forest.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -河流競賽
programme.desc: Darwin, Newts and Heni compete in a river race using rubber band boats, but when Newts' boat zooms off in the wrong direction, they have to work out why.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -願原力與你同在
programme.desc: Eric learns about tiny electrons and how they are connected to creating static electricity. Then he rubs his head with a balloon to create his own static electricity, and uses this to move an object without touching it.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -貓熊與金剛鸚鵡
programme.desc: Posse, the red panda, and Santiago, the saki, have been having issues with their teeth and the dentist brought his big pliers! Ever heard the tale of how the blue-throated macaw parrot was saved from extinction and started a new fashion trend in the process.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -艾瑞克造紙
programme.desc: Eric learns how to make a beautiful sheet of recycled paper. He finds out what people used to write on before paper was invented.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -虎鯨寶寶
programme.desc: Morgan, the deaf orca, is about to give birth to her very first calf. The stakes are high, and the staff at Loro Parque are holding their collective breath as the scene is set for the greatest natural phenomenon in the zoo's history.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -風箏把戲
programme.desc: Eric builds a new kite. He makes sure it is symmetrical – both sides are exactly the same – as that helps kites fly and stay balanced in the air. He learns that there are lots of different types of kites but they all need the wind to fly.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -壯觀的病菌
programme.desc: Eric discovers that washing your hands can prevent the spread of bacteria. He does an experiment to show how easy it is to spread these tiny germs from person to person.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -希望與夢想
programme.desc: The Icicles have made it to the World Synchro Championships and are heading to Canada. After a season of flawless performances, can the girls pull off their Bollywood routine? The end of season Gala is near, but preparations aren't running as smoothly as everyone hoped.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -宴會時間
programme.desc: As the ice skating season draws to a close, there is the annual event in the calendar that everyone is talking about. All the Ice Stars gather together for some sensational Hollywood-themed performances. For the Icicles, it's the last time they'll skate together.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -金色大門
programme.desc: A group of young adventurers travel by bus, horse and helicopter through Golden Gate Highlands National Park in South Africa. They learn about the origins of the natural world and discover some rock art.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -激流巨響
programme.desc: A group of young adventurers travel to Augrabies Falls National Park in South Africa to discover the secrets of life in the desert. They spot many wild animals and face their fears on a trip to white water rapids.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -國王企鵝
programme.desc: Annabelle, the king penguin, is displaying some worrying symptoms. She's waving her head about skywards and Jorge is concerned she may have some neurological problems. Will Annabelle rejoin her friends on the great, icy mound at Loro Parque ever again.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -烏龜菲德莉卡
programme.desc: Federica, the turtle, has arrived from Italy after a run-in with a container ship. Loro Parque has offered to be her ‘forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? Esmeralda, the iguana, has a lumpy belly and Jorge, the vet, is worried.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -大溪地之旅

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -日本之旅, 第二部
programme.desc: Our heroes prepare for a sleepover in the HQ, but it seems impossible to divide the space, so they each have a separate bedroom. Alim knows of places where people feel more comfortable sleeping together in the same room. Everyone is soon in Japan for a new adventure.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -馬利之旅
programme.desc: Milo is trying to learn his poem but is having a hard time remembering the words. Alim thinks it is easier to learn something while listening to music! Zoe and Milo do not seem convinced, and Alim decides that only a short break to Mali could change this.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -加納利群島之旅
programme.desc: Is it possible to communicate over a distance with neither telephone nor internet access? A little trip to the Canary Islands could answer the question. With the help of their penfriend Kiko, our friends will learn to use the landscape to communicate with others.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -戀愛艾伯特
programme.desc: Little Albert is infatuated with Jessie and will try anything to win her love, even if it involves pretending to be something he's not. He eventually learns that he doesn't need to go to such lengths to impress her.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -瘋狂坑洞
programme.desc: Eric learns that most asteroids burn out before they reach our planet. But sometimes, when they're super huge, they hit Earth and make really big craters. He does an experiment to show what would happen in that situation.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -蛋的冒險之旅
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts find a mysterious egg on the beach, and try to find out who it might belong to. They discover it's a sea turtle when the whole beach hatches at once.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -滑雪冒險
programme.desc: Darwin, Newts, Burpee, and Kea set off on a cross country skiing adventure to visit a glacier, and learn some cool science along the way.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -寫程式和編碼
programme.desc: How did people compute before the invention of computers? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of computing. Have hands-on fun by making your own abacus, and get to know Ada Lovelace, the first computer programmer before the invention of computers.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -瘋狂的催化劑
programme.desc: What is a catalyst? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of chemical engineering. Have hands-on fun by producing your own cheese, and get to know Ryong Ryoo, who discovered a rock trapping water inside it can serve as catalyst in petrochemicals.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -失蹤的長毛象
programme.desc: Ms. Bell has planned to surprise her students by hiding mammoth fossils in the school sandpit for them to dig up. But the surprise is on Ms. Bell and her students when the fossils disappear – and Addison has figure out where they went.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -可疑的圓圈之謎
programme.desc: When crop circles begin appearing in Ayrton Park, Alex suspects visitors from the fourth dimension, but Addison begins sleuthing in search of a different explanation.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -奧托翻煎餅
programme.desc: Determined to win a shiny trophy of his own, Oto decides to attempt a world record for the biggest pancake. But can he really make it all by himself? The team sets off to a pancake festival at a Sugarbush in Quebec, Canada, to find out.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -多奇與蝙蝠
programme.desc: Fico wants Anabella to help him create a comic book about a bat superhero! But Anabella needs to see a real bat to draw one. Doki is nervous to go on this expedition. He's heard that bats drink your blood and tangle in your hair. Why shouldn't he be afraid of bats.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -金屬拉環
programme.desc: Ah after a refreshing drink don't throw away the metal tabs, save em! We have some amazing we can make with them.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -CD
programme.desc: So colourful, so shiny let's re use them to make some cool accessories.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -拉法的一天
programme.desc: Meet the Loro Parque Foundation Scientific Director - Rafa, also known as the ‘Birdman of Loro Parque'. He wears the badge with pride and every day he surrounds himself with all things ornithological - from parrots and puffins to penguins.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -大猩猩醫腳
programme.desc: Ubongo, the gorilla, has a massive cut on his foot. But how do you treat a 400-pound gorilla with a sore foot? And have you ever seen a sloth take a shower? Hugo, the sloth, will draw back the shower curtain and reveal all.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -髒兮兮
programme.desc: Sir Howler is expecting a visit from the king any second! Only problem is, the town where he lives is a total garbage dump! So the Little Urchins get to work to make the place look spic and span, demonstrating the spectrum of medieval cleaning techniques.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -攻城掠地
programme.desc: For ‘noble knight' Sir Howler, taking Lord Roach's fortress by storm is a real conundrum! But our formidable war leader's inventiveness comes in very useful! All the attack techniques in the book are deployed to invade his most loyal enemy's abode.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -神話與傳說
programme.desc: After taking care of his daily chores, Howler ‘gets away from it all' by daydreaming about wonderful encounters! In the process, he takes us through various contemporary beliefs, myths and legends, powered by his very rich imagination.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -隱藏寶石之謎
programme.desc: When Addison and Tess find a note in a funny old pair of rummage sale pants, they think they may have found a clue to lead them to a stash of priceless hidden diamonds.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -壞女孩一號偵探社之謎
programme.desc: When the school mean girls, Katie and Dinara, start their own detective agency and solve a rash of neighbourhood mysteries before Addison can, she wonders if she's lost her touch...or if there is something else more nefarious going on.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -金屬瓶蓋
programme.desc: The best news is that Hepi and Briko have figured out some exciting DIYs with metal caps.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -衣架
programme.desc: Oh no what to do with all these extra cloth hangers? Worry not, we have ideas that will upcycle these to the next level.

programme.desc: Unlike life in our modern society, in the Middle Ages, people don't eat their fill every day. We follow our foodie Howler as he scavenges around for anything that takes his fancy, overstepping his mark as a mere peasant.

programme.title: 優可 -在野外露營
programme.desc: The kids learn that sometimes too many rules can ruin the fun when a spirited game gets a bit overly complicated.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -超大號里歐
programme.desc: Sprinter feels bad that Leo is so small. He builds her a machine that alters the size of things. Leo is, after all, fine being small. Sprinter could learn by looking at things from another perspective.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -消失無蹤
programme.desc: When Leo disappears, Bumble has to help Sprinter find her. All traces lead to Cleopatra, but she won`t admit anything. Soon, Bumble goes missing too! Sprinter realises that the only solution is to let himself get caught.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -鑽油平台
programme.desc: A visit to an oil platform leads to an accident that Kit and Mr. Battery must set right.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -海嘯
programme.desc: Kit and Mr. Battery fight the albatross for the stolen safety buoys.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -泰國之旅
programme.desc: Is there a country where even toddlers happily eat the spiciest dishes? Our heroes travel to Thailand to find out. And Alim's penfriend Narawan prepares a spicy meal.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -加拿大之旅

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -伊朗之旅
programme.desc: Zoe has to make some complicated calculations, but she has no electronic device at hand that could help her with that, so she is in a bit of a panic. Milo does not seem to have an answer. As for Alim, he sees the solution to her problems in a trip to Iran.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -皇家派對
programme.desc: Team Doki is invited to a dinner party at a palace in Denmark. They're excited to be going to such a fancy affair. Anabella and Gabi worry that Fico might embarrass them with his poor table manners! Doki doesn't think it's a big deal. What are manners for, anyway.

programme.title: 叢林樂節拍 -螞蟻--在風中飄蕩
programme.desc: Ant is tasked with taking a leaf back to his anthill. This seems simple enough until nature conspires to make it a task of Herculian proportions.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -英雄養成學校
programme.desc: It's hard to be the only superhero, and in an attempt to share the responsibilities, Sprinter starts a school to train more heroes. However, when the villains suddenly show up on the field, the students have to take a very early exam.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -贏家獨裁索爾
programme.desc: DiktaThor has always dreamed of having power over Bhilka. Suddenly it happens and he takes control over Bhilka. But is it a dream that came true, or is it a nightmare.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -維京人

programme.desc: Albert eats a flower that gives him super powers, and he uses them to take revenge on the kids who have tormented him throughout his life. But with great power comes great irresponsibility..

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -增大機

長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第二十一集：大庾嶺的路
programme.desc: 阿柴祭奠阿土，在地上劃出家鄉山嶺的走向，這是峒人的習俗，方便魂魄找回家。李善德覺得地上畫的路很熟悉，又掏出瞎姑娘送自己的手帕，發現手帕上正是大庾嶺那邊的山勢。李善德恍然大悟，趕緊去找來地圖比對.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: 聯合國建議城市需有三成土地作公共空間，並指與市民心理健康及社區凝聚力息息相關。香港地少人多，人均休憩用地低於其他亞洲主要城市，未來新發展區雖計劃將人均休憩用地提升至3.5平方米，但空間是否足夠？與其單純追求數字，如何善用現有空間或許更值得探討。本集訪問空間使用者及學者，從不同角度審視公共空間的運用，探討在高密度城市中，如何真正發揮其凝聚社區的價值.

programme.title: 大自然逐樣解4
programme.desc: 《大自然逐樣解4》邀請了嶺南大學科學教研部研究助理教授曾憲發博士，分享有關外來魚種的生態知識。本集以寶石魚、金山鯽和食蚊魚作例子，並利用XR擴增實境技術，以全面生態視野去探索外來魚種的外貌特徵、食性、以及生活習性.

programme.title: 民生美食關注組
programme.desc: 今集主持將會帶觀眾走一條地道美食路線，深入深水埗、太子及太安樓，品嚐從傳統中式糕點到異國印尼風味的多元滋味，全方位體驗香港最真實的社區魅力.

programme.title: 無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第四十集：羅英子和温莉最終見面
programme.desc: 在羅英子的安排下，劉銘母親找到溫莉。劉母要求她三天內把轉走的錢還回來，否則就報警，溫莉口頭答應。溫莉意識到國內暫時不能待了，說服小丁去美國發展，臨行前溫莉還讓小丁再和父親要一筆錢。老丁同意，但要求走公司賬。温莉臨離開之際，羅英子出現在她的面前….

programme.title: 31看世界 - 尋色中國
programme.desc: 聚焦女性與色彩的深層聯結，打破性別刻板印象。通過傳統服飾、漆器及妝容中的色彩運用，展現女性在文化傳承中的獨特地位，如手工藝者調製漆色、織造絲綢的細膩技藝。以生活場景烘托色彩美學，揭示傳統色譜中蘊含的女性力量與創造力.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 尋色中國
programme.desc: 聚焦自然色彩的人文轉化，通過山水畫、陶瓷釉色等案例，展現中國人將自然色譜轉化為藝術表達的智慧。以青綠山水、青花鈷料為例，揭示傳統色彩在絹帛、瓷器上的詩意呈現，體現「天人合一」的美學追求.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小米發現新書，小麥找到外公的潛水艇畫，決定去史前世界尋找潛水艇。沙沙羅建議去奶昔的湖，但被告知沒有潛水艇。最終他們問雷卡，得知潛水艇在巨齒鯊那裡，並反省應聽取木瓜的意見，一起探索水下世界.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 假期最後一天，小米、小麥和茜茜決定畫畫送給史前朋友們，但茜茜覺得不完美。他們回到史前世界，恐龍們舉辦派對，沙沙羅送出捕夢網。茜茜因離別難過，小米安慰她，木瓜帶來巨大冰淇淋，大家不捨道別，期待再相聚.

programme.title: 冰雪尖刀連
programme.sub-title: 第二集：伍千里想帶萬里當兵
programme.desc: 梅生帶着妻女回家，心情複雜，和妻子互訴衷腸。伍千里告訴父母建國後分地的好消息，想帶弟弟萬里當兵，母親不捨兒子再離開。軍營中，七連戰士積極備戰，戰友打趣排長布認命的感情煩惱。伍家依習俗撒百里的骨灰於太湖，發現子彈頭倍感心痛.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 尋色中國
programme.desc: 聚焦自然色彩的人文轉化，通過山水畫、陶瓷釉色等案例，展現中國人將自然色譜轉化為藝術表達的智慧。以青綠山水、青花鈷料為例，揭示傳統色彩在絹帛、瓷器上的詩意呈現，體現「天人合一」的美學追求.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.sub-title: 《CEPA修訂協議二》 新措施、新商機
programme.desc: 國家商務部與特區政府在《內地與香港關於建立更緊密經貿關係的安排》(CEPA)框架下簽署的《關於修訂〈CEPA服務貿易協議〉的協議二》（《修訂協議二》），已於2025年3月1日起實施。《修訂協議二》進一步對香港開放內地的服務業市場，讓香港企業和專業人士能以更優惠的待遇進入內地市場。本集邀請三位分別來自電信、旅遊，以及法律界的企業和機構代表分享他們利用CEPA新措施開拓內地市場新商機的成功經驗.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第二集: 黃玲、宋瑩成為鄰居
programme.desc: 林、莊兩家相處融洽，互相幫忙。隔壁的王勇把排水開向林、莊兩家那邊，把雨水灌過來，身為工程師林武峰就把排水口封了。林棟哲的褲子爛了，家有縫紉機的黃玲幫忙把褲子補好。莊英超弟弟想要把兩個孩子送到莊超英這裡來，黃玲很不高興。但莊超英說自己姪子要來怎麼不行.

programme.title: 小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第三集: 黃玲心疼兒女
programme.desc: 黃玲帶著兩個孩子回娘家去了。宋瑩和林武峰跟莊超英說，一代還一代，黃玲保護自己的孩子是有原因的。莊超英去接黃玲和孩子們回來過年，生活不好也互相幫孩子包紅包。莊超英帶着圖南到高考放榜的地方，表示這些孩子考上了好大學，希望圖南能好好讀書，也去好大學看一看.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.sub-title: 香港貿易發展局 - 東方之「珠」
programme.desc: 政府計劃把香港打造成展示內地及海外品牌的首選平台，預留一億元吸引嶄新元素的大型展覽來港。每年三月的國際珠寶展匯聚多家來自全球的展商，展示裸石、成品等珠寶手飾，是甚麼吸引他們來港參展? 作為主辨方的香港貿易發展局未來又會如何把握發展機遇，推動展覽業發展呢.

programme.title: 長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第二十二集：何有光派人追殺李善德
programme.desc: 眾人送別李善德，他正式開始第一次的荔枝試驗。何有光得知李善德已經帶轉運隊伍趕回長安，派人去追殺。林邑奴聽聞此事，故意將追兵引上錯路，向李善德報恩.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
Dream Chasers
programme.desc: 陳文慧 Rosie，畢業自理大環境及室內設計系，在學期間專注鑽研廚餘處理，發現昆蟲黑水虻有效消滅廚餘，便研發全港首個家居廚餘回收站，畢業後，Rosie成立科創公司，繼續進行利用生物科技解決廚餘的相關研發。. 帶著一份「減少垃圾、改善生活」的初心，Rosie連獲多個創科獎項及基金支持。更參與了青協的「創科N世代」計劃，為她提供重要助力。近期她希望將廚餘機引入更多學校，處理超過100噸廚餘。一邊處理廚餘，一邊加強宣傳教育，提升港人的減廢意識.

programme.title: 濾鏡
programme.sub-title: 第一集：蘇橙橙獲贈神奇手鐲
programme.desc: 一天，蘇橙橙出門在公車上見義勇為救了一個被猥瑣男欺負的女孩，期間她的臉突然發生變異…。下車後，她回憶着過去，時光霎時回到了三個月前她到美妝公司參加面試卻直接被淘汰的時候。之後，她又在校友會上出了洋相，傷心之際，意外遇到一個老奶奶並得到了一隻神奇手鐲.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
31看世界 - 本草流芳
programme.desc: 今天，人們從黃連中提取出黃連素，廣泛應用於中藥製劑、保健品、化妝品等領域。千百年來，面對千般磨難，中國人往往會道一句：辛苦。苦，正是黃連的本味。幾千年時間，中國人用此一味，清熱解毒，寬慰人生.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 本草流芳
programme.desc: 泡水、煲湯，搭配萬物，它是今天年輕人追捧的養生法寶，也是傳承數千年的滋補良藥。春采葉、夏採花、秋采子、冬采根，一株植物全身是寶。它總是以幹皺的形態默默等待，將自己舒展在每一個需要它的時刻，它就是枸杞.

programme.title: 夜．遊香港
programme.sub-title: 第五晚—維港夜釣「魚」你共樂
programme.desc: 夜晚一個人感到無聊？但不想再困在商場與手機之間？. 今集邀請大家跟隨主持孝仔展開一趟維多利亞港夜遊之旅，乘船出海夜釣，看看這位釣魚新手能否成功在維港釣到魚?除了跟隨船長及其他釣魚前輩學釣魚及釣魷魚之外，還會一齊欣賞「幻彩詠香江」與維港夜色，細聽他們分享為何熱愛釣魚，以及如何用一晚海風與燈影，暫時卸下生活壓力。即使孝仔最終能否釣到漁獲仍是未知數，但笑聲與人情味已經足夠令你不枉此行。. 想知道他最後可否釣到魚「收工」而回？就一同登船見證吧.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
綠惜見未來
programme.desc: Hong Kong generates around 11,000 tonnes of municipal solid waste (MSW) daily, most of which ends up in landfills. With limited land resources and ever-increasing waste, landfills are approaching full capacity. To tackle this, the government has accelerated the development of "Waste to Energy" facilities, such as incinerators (I·PARKs), sludge treatment facilities (T·PARK), and organic waste recovery centres (O·PARKs). These aim to reduce landfill reliance and turn waste into valuable resources. . Incineration technology, already widely used overseas, will soon be introduced to Hong Kong with the completion of the first next-generation incinerator (I·PARK1) in 2025. It is expected to process 3,000 tonnes of MSW daily and convert waste into electricity. Older incinerators were known to release harmful pollutants like dioxins, but how will this new technology minimizes emissions? What other environmental policies can support its implementation.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海
programme.sub-title: 第二十四集：肖春生的腿開始恢復
programme.desc: 坐在輪椅上的肖春生碰到李上游，被羞辱，更被推倒在地。肖春生又失去了信心，曉梅不斷安慰他。肖春生的腿開始恢復，可以走兩步。齊天和肖豔秋的生意被李上游算計。他們和肖春生商量怎麼辦。葉芳告訴肖春生，佟曉梅從一開始就喜歡他。李上游攔著佟曉梅想要她手裏的儀器.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海
programme.sub-title: 第二十五集：肖春生向佟曉梅告白
programme.desc: 肖春生到佟曉梅家，提前送上生日禮物，是醫學的書。佟曉梅帶肖春生進了自己房間，肖春生無意中看到書桌上的《護理札記》，他終於發現佟曉梅就是他的書庫女孩。在去書庫的路上，肖春生向佟曉梅告白，佟曉梅同意。賀紅玲病倒住院，葉國華去看她，卻聽到昏迷中她喊肖春生.

programme.sub-title: 亞洲青年管弦樂團延續承諾音樂會
programme.desc: 亞洲青年管弦樂團於2023年夏天聚首一堂。為延續33年前樂團創辦人許下的承諾，超過九十位亞洲青年音樂家在世界各地包括意大利、德國、泰國、台灣、日本和香港進行15場巡演，為聽眾帶來氣勢磅礡、澎湃昂揚的音樂，這次旅程亦為各位青年音樂家帶來難能可貴的回憶。. 演出曲目：. 葛令卡：《魯斯蘭與柳德米拉》序曲. Glinka: Ruslan & Lyudmila Overture. 史特拉汶斯基：《火鳥》組曲(1919). Stravinsky: Firebird Suite (1919). 馬勒：G大調第四號交響曲. Mahler: Symphony No.4 in G major. 馬勒：呂克特之歌《若你鍾情於美麗》. Mahler: Lovest thou but beauty. 指揮Conductor 巴斯蒂安(Joseph Bastian). 女高音Soprano 莉迪亞·托伊舍(Lydia Teuscher). 演出. 亞洲青年管弦樂團(Asian Youth Orchestra).

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
《科學 ∙ 創未來3》
programme.desc: An annual mega event for the scientific community, the Future Science Prize Award Ceremony, was successfully held for the third time in Hong Kong. Three grand prizes – Life Science Prize, Physical Science Prize, and Mathematics and Computer Science Prize were successfully awarded to seven scientists. . As in previous years, the Award Ceremony came with the Future Science Prize Week events where elites in the scientific community from around the world gathered together, including several Nobel Prize laureates. During the 5-day events such as the Science Symposiums, Science and Technology Forum, and Asian Young Scientist Fellowship Annual Conference, the elites gathered together for mutual interaction and exchange. . In order to popularise science at all levels and inspire young people, the organiser held multiple science popularisation events hosted by laureates to share their journeys of scientific research and expose young people and the public to science closely.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 特殊的孩子要成長，背後的家人就是推手。這些父母在覺察孩子有特殊的一刻已經備受煎熬，在漫長的歲月中，除了要付出無窮精力與耐性，同時要默默忍受別人不解的異樣眼光。他們的情緒健康亦同樣需要得到正視。. 劉國威Wallace的兒子是自閉症和輕度智障、翁太的女兒是唐氏飛魚翁欣怡、徐江琼的女兒有雷特氏症、鍾曼姿關注SEN家長，今集主持Marco和Vita會和他們傾計，談談照顧者的關注，分享兩代人如何才能共同健康成長.

programme.title: 中華知識王2
programme.sub-title: 第二集 - 周吉佩、練美娟、岑珈其 | 漢朝漢服大解構！
programme.desc: 今集歌手周吉佩(吉吉)、主持練美娟(娟娟)和演員岑珈其(珈其)鬥知又鬥智，面對歷史地理、體育、憲法及文學等題目，吉吉和珈其聯手追擊娟娟，娟娟能否突圍而出？影片題帶嘉賓走訪安徽合肥探訪清末重臣李鴻章故居。近年興起漢服熱潮，漢服的箇中細節知識你又認識幾多？增進中華知識，留意《中華知識王2》！. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌陽. 嘉賓：周吉佩、練美娟、岑珈其. #中華知識王#曾卓然#糖妹#阮頌陽#周吉佩#練美娟#岑珈其#安徽合肥#漢朝#漢服#古代服飾.

programme.title: 周末大電影 : 我左眼見到鬼
programme.desc: 何麗珠(鄭秀文飾)一次在外地旅遊,邂逅年青商家 Daniel,相識七日閃電結婚,但未及回港 Daniel 便意外溺斃。珠繼承亡夫的大筆遺產,終日無所事事只沉溺煙酒。一日,珠駕著丈夫生前喜愛的古董車,發生意外,珠的靈魂被撞至飛出軀體,鬼魂王勁威(劉青雲飾)出現逼珠的靈魂返回到軀體內.珠大難不死後,自此便左眼見到鬼. . .

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: 聯合國建議城市需有三成土地作公共空間，並指與市民心理健康及社區凝聚力息息相關。香港地少人多，人均休憩用地低於其他亞洲主要城市，未來新發展區雖計劃將人均休憩用地提升至3.5平方米，但空間是否足夠？與其單純追求數字，如何善用現有空間或許更值得探討。本集訪問空間使用者及學者，從不同角度審視公共空間的運用，探討在高密度城市中，如何真正發揮其凝聚社區的價值.

programme.title: 醫生與你
programme.desc: 「人人叫我不要太擔憂，但我控制不了呢……」. 焦慮是與生俱來的正常情緒反應，每個人也試過因為各種挑戰或者未明的將來而感到焦慮。但是，當「擔憂」變成無法揮去的陰霾，影響日常生活，甚至引發心跳加速、失眠、肌肉繃緊時，你可能患上了「焦慮症」。「焦慮症」並非洪水猛獸，它如其他疾病一樣，是可以治療的。本集節目邀請臨床心理學家，深入探究焦慮症的成因、誘發點、包含認知行為治療在內的多元療法，讓大家克服沉重的焦慮。. 主持：黃秉康醫生、羅鈺文. 嘉賓：關澄博士(香港中文大學醫學院精神科學系香港健康情緒中心臨床心理學家).

programme.title: 中華知識王2
programme.sub-title: 第二集 - 周吉佩、練美娟、岑珈其 | 漢朝漢服大解構！
programme.desc: 今集歌手周吉佩(吉吉)、主持練美娟(娟娟)和演員岑珈其(珈其)鬥知又鬥智，面對歷史地理、體育、憲法及文學等題目，吉吉和珈其聯手追擊娟娟，娟娟能否突圍而出？影片題帶嘉賓走訪安徽合肥探訪清末重臣李鴻章故居。近年興起漢服熱潮，漢服的箇中細節知識你又認識幾多？增進中華知識，留意《中華知識王2》！. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌陽. 嘉賓：周吉佩、練美娟、岑珈其. #中華知識王#曾卓然#糖妹#阮頌陽#周吉佩#練美娟#岑珈其#安徽合肥#漢朝#漢服#古代服飾.

programme.title: 我親愛的 Donovan
programme.sub-title: 第十六集：外公要求Pam分手
programme.desc: Pam明確回絕谷先生表白，同時得知Donovan分手實為換取Jessica救她的交易。Donovan取消協議後飛奔挽回，兩人盡釋前嫌。為求家庭認可，Donovan直面外公偏見，衝突中槍意外走火擊傷母親，卻反令母女和解、外公愧疚接納。所有障礙掃清後，Donovan在海邊用刻字戒指求婚成功。兩個曾破碎的靈魂，如拼圖般終成圓滿.

programme.title: 綠惜見未來
programme.desc: Hong Kong generates around 11,000 tonnes of municipal solid waste (MSW) daily, most of which ends up in landfills. With limited land resources and ever-increasing waste, landfills are approaching full capacity. To tackle this, the government has accelerated the development of "Waste to Energy" facilities, such as incinerators (I·PARKs), sludge treatment facilities (T·PARK), and organic waste recovery centres (O·PARKs). These aim to reduce landfill reliance and turn waste into valuable resources. . Incineration technology, already widely used overseas, will soon be introduced to Hong Kong with the completion of the first next-generation incinerator (I·PARK1) in 2025. It is expected to process 3,000 tonnes of MSW daily and convert waste into electricity. Older incinerators were known to release harmful pollutants like dioxins, but how will this new technology minimizes emissions? What other environmental policies can support its implementation.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂
programme.desc: 隱身於重慶大廈的非洲菜小店，由加納人Paul 及香港人Selina兩夫婦於十年前創立。他們希望透過異國美食，例如加納羊腩金錢肚堅果濃湯和原條炸鯽魚，為客人帶來一刻喘息的空間。兩口子一起並肩作戰，堂食、外賣和到會都一一做好，可惜的是Paul於2024年因病離世，但Selina會堅持把餐廳營運下去，延續Paul的精神.

programme.title: 典故裏的科學 第二季
programme.desc: 遠遊對於現代人來說常見，但是在古代卻不一樣。《韓非子·說林上》中這樣寫道：「春往冬返，迷惑失道。管仲曰：老馬之智可用也。乃放老馬而隨之，遂得道。」這便是「老馬識途」的典故。老馬真的能够識途？科學求證人高澤民帶着疑問來到了雲南省大理市鳳陽邑村一探究竟.

programme.title: 念
programme.desc: 器官捐贈微電影《念》，講述一位母親為離世兒子捐出器官時，所經歷嘅思念與抉擇，以及捐出兒子器官後，見證到受贈者與家屬重獲新生而萌生的全新體會。希望透過微電影鼓勵大眾踏出重要一步，支持器官捐贈，讓受贈者及他們的家人得到第二人生.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今次再次探訪靜內地區，大家在5月中種植的稻米，現在已經可以收割了！觀看過收割機的收割過程後，大家去到倉庫學習由稻變成白米的工序。小農夫由播種、種植、收割、研磨都一一體驗.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 小特不小心吃了變壞了的杯子蛋糕，結果引發了一連串「臭氣熏天」的效應！其他海鸚夥伴被這股可怕的氣味嚇得四散，卻不幸落入了奧圖的魔爪.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 灶君接到天庭旨意帶領灶雞下界守護人間家庭傳播和睦，原本要選一個清閒人家少管閒事的灶君，不料被人間趙家的兩個小孩打掃房間時，用吸塵器吸入趙家.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 落入趙家的灶君不僅自己的寵物爐雞與這家的機器寵物球球碰撞導致合體，更是發現趙家清鍋冷灶雜事多，想要享清閒的灶君決定趕在落戶系統關閉前離開趙家重新擇定人家，然而灶君的法器神環損壞，同時趙家人發現灶君是居家一把好手，正好解決自家亂成一團的生活，於是以修神環為條件讓灶君幫忙解決生活煩惱，一切搞定，灶君正要離開，沒想到落戶系統關閉，灶君正式入戶趙家.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 在蒼穹之下，屋脊之巔，有一支神秘的如福侍衛隊。小學三年級學生徐菲菲意外闖入如福與對手朝風的決鬥，導致如福首領失踪，五隻脊獸墜落人間。菲菲意外成為他們的新隊長.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 菲菲在落葉中發現了第一隻脊獸—隨你，並帶回家。隨後，他們遭到朝風派出的烏鴉攻擊。在躲避過程中遇到另一隻脊獸—俠魚，兩者聯手趕走烏鴉。大桔誤會菲菲想偷襲，俠魚和隨你制止了他，三者順利會合.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 大約13000年前，定居在北歐的蜜蜂因寒冷而被迫遷徙。在塞文山脈，這片山谷形成了天然屏障，使得純種蜜蜂群落得以適應環境並生存下來。如今，人們重新回歸祖先的傳統，以保護這些珍貴的蜜蜂.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 每年，在印度西南部，狩獵採集者都期待遷徙蜜蜂的到來——世界上最具攻擊性的巨型蜜蜂喜馬拉雅崖蜂（Apis dorsata）。隨著參與這項危險採集的人越來越少，部落決心將這一任務傳授給他們的兒子和侄子，以確保家族的生計，並防止這項延續了數個世紀的傳統消失.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: When "YouTuber" replaces doctors and lawyers as the most coveted career among younger generations, it signals a revolution in values. A recent survey shows that among the Alpha generation, over 30% of teenagers regard content creation as their ideal profession. This shift not only overturns the traditional notion of “prestigious occupations” but also highlights that the new generation’s definition of “success” has moved from social status to self‑fulfillment. Hong Kong Connection will explore the underlying social phenomena.

programme.title: 香港故事：情繫香港
programme.sub-title: The Hong Kong Chapter of Iranian Scholars
programme.desc: There are approximately 150 individuals from Iran currently residing and thriving in Hong Kong, with students and academics making up a significant portion of this community. In this episode, we delve into the lives of two exceptional Iranian scholars pursuing their studies here. . Majan, who settled in Hong Kong at the age of 12, has shown remarkable determination in her pursuit of excellence. She has effortlessly learned to speak Cantonese, Putonghua, and English. Academically, she has achieved outstanding results, leading to her admission to HKU for cancer research. From Majan's experience, Hong Kong has proven to be a place where anyone can thrive. . Behzad, on the other hand, began his research on pediatric respiratory diseases at the Chinese University of Hong Kong in 2019. His outgoing and friendly character has helped him build strong friendships with locals. With the abundant resources available in Hong Kong's universities, Behzad has been able to conduct research that would have been challenging to pursue in his home country.

programme.title: 大自然深度遊 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 城门郊野公园成立于1977年，是香港其中一个早期设立的郊野公园，范围包括大帽山、草山及针山，内里也有城门水塘、白千层林等景点。. 郊野公园内草木繁盛，有丰富多样的生态值得我们去探索。既可以欣赏到登峰的各种蝴蝶，也可以在大城石涧中找到可爱的淡水鱼。. 不过称霸城门的生物，一定要数山上群居的猴子，仅在城门郊野公园已经有至少四个可见族群。今次由专家教主持远距离观察猴子的生活习惯，并学习和猴子们在山上共存的秘诀.

programme.desc: In the deep south during the 1930s, three escaped convicts search for hidden treasure while a relentless lawman pursues them.

programme.title: 好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special
programme.desc: 今集收到來自小學六年級生思思的訊息，因為她眼見排隊時給領袖生及一位身體不適的同學打尖的，心裡極受委屈，感覺十分不公平，於是向Harry哥哥求助；而其他學生亦對這件事議論紛紛，到底誰對誰錯？就在大家辯論之際，貓頭鷹博士及時出現，並引用了《基本法》第二十五條；但是當公平遇上特殊情況，我們如何做到情、理、法三者兼備呢？. 《基本法》第二十五條. 香港居民在法律面前一律平等。. 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 快歌節拍強勁，令人聞歌起舞，慢歌溫柔深情，扣人心弦。哥哥張國榮的舞台魔力，不止令老樂迷懷念不已，更吸引到許多新生代，在他離開之後才紛紛成為他的粉絲。百聽不厭，歷久常新，更擁有不斷滋長的生命力，是為不朽。在這個春暖花開的時候，讓我們再一次重溫張國榮在舞台上的完美演出。. 主持. 李志剛.

programme.title: Dream Chasers
programme.desc: 陳文慧 Rosie，畢業自理大環境及室內設計系，在學期間專注鑽研廚餘處理，發現昆蟲黑水虻有效消滅廚餘，便研發全港首個家居廚餘回收站，畢業後，Rosie成立科創公司，繼續進行利用生物科技解決廚餘的相關研發。. 帶著一份「減少垃圾、改善生活」的初心，Rosie連獲多個創科獎項及基金支持。更參與了青協的「創科N世代」計劃，為她提供重要助力。近期她希望將廚餘機引入更多學校，處理超過100噸廚餘。一邊處理廚餘，一邊加強宣傳教育，提升港人的減廢意識.

programme.title: 西藏·星空下的傳奇
programme.desc: 第一集《星曆》聚焦西藏天文曆算非遺解碼西藏天文曆算的時空密碼。以傳承人丹增主導的十二年藏曆運算為脈絡，串聯《春牛圖》等智慧結晶，展現林芝、阿里等地依藏曆而生的新年習俗.

programme.title: 運動教室31(第三季)
programme.sub-title: 運動教室31 (第３季) 第十二集
programme.desc: 曲棍球、殘疾人羽毛球及硬地滾球.

programme.title: 大自然深度遊 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 城门郊野公园成立于1977年，是香港其中一个早期设立的郊野公园，范围包括大帽山、草山及针山，内里也有城门水塘、白千层林等景点。. 郊野公园内草木繁盛，有丰富多样的生态值得我们去探索。既可以欣赏到登峰的各种蝴蝶，也可以在大城石涧中找到可爱的淡水鱼。. 不过称霸城门的生物，一定要数山上群居的猴子，仅在城门郊野公园已经有至少四个可见族群。今次由专家教主持远距离观察猴子的生活习惯，并学习和猴子们在山上共存的秘诀.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: When "YouTuber" replaces doctors and lawyers as the most coveted career among younger generations, it signals a revolution in values. A recent survey shows that among the Alpha generation, over 30% of teenagers regard content creation as their ideal profession. This shift not only overturns the traditional notion of “prestigious occupations” but also highlights that the new generation’s definition of “success” has moved from social status to self‑fulfillment. Hong Kong Connection will explore the underlying social phenomena.

programme.title: 香港故事：情繫香港
programme.sub-title: The Hong Kong Chapter of Iranian Scholars
programme.desc: There are approximately 150 individuals from Iran currently residing and thriving in Hong Kong, with students and academics making up a significant portion of this community. In this episode, we delve into the lives of two exceptional Iranian scholars pursuing their studies here. . Majan, who settled in Hong Kong at the age of 12, has shown remarkable determination in her pursuit of excellence. She has effortlessly learned to speak Cantonese, Putonghua, and English. Academically, she has achieved outstanding results, leading to her admission to HKU for cancer research. From Majan's experience, Hong Kong has proven to be a place where anyone can thrive. . Behzad, on the other hand, began his research on pediatric respiratory diseases at the Chinese University of Hong Kong in 2019. His outgoing and friendly character has helped him build strong friendships with locals. With the abundant resources available in Hong Kong's universities, Behzad has been able to conduct research that would have been challenging to pursue in his home country.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 大約13000年前，定居在北歐的蜜蜂因寒冷而被迫遷徙。在塞文山脈，這片山谷形成了天然屏障，使得純種蜜蜂群落得以適應環境並生存下來。如今，人們重新回歸祖先的傳統，以保護這些珍貴的蜜蜂.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 每年，在印度西南部，狩獵採集者都期待遷徙蜜蜂的到來——世界上最具攻擊性的巨型蜜蜂喜馬拉雅崖蜂（Apis dorsata）。隨著參與這項危險採集的人越來越少，部落決心將這一任務傳授給他們的兒子和侄子，以確保家族的生計，並防止這項延續了數個世紀的傳統消失.

programme.title: 冰雪尖刀連
programme.sub-title: 第三集：梅生告別妻子回歸部隊
programme.desc: 梅生看到美軍出兵朝鮮的新聞後，決定歸隊，跟妻子含淚告別。伍千里獲父母默許，帶萬里參軍。布認命與寧寧互許終生，但接到緊急出發命令，憂慮難安。梅生妻子追上梅生，重溫大學戀情，再次念起《我儂詞》。二四〇團整備出發，千里帶萬里見證出征情景.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.sub-title: 非物質文化遺產辦事處 - 移動．非遺
programme.desc: 非物質文化遺產辦事處資助計劃——非遺專車「移動．非遺」，於2025至2027年間走訪香港各區學校及公眾地方，透過精心設計的活動、展覽和互動裝置，讓大眾寓學習於富趣味的遊戲之中，認識香港非遺的豐富內涵.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
31看世界 - 本草流芳
programme.desc: 今天，人們從黃連中提取出黃連素，廣泛應用於中藥製劑、保健品、化妝品等領域。千百年來，面對千般磨難，中國人往往會道一句：辛苦。苦，正是黃連的本味。幾千年時間，中國人用此一味，清熱解毒，寬慰人生.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 本草流芳
programme.desc: 泡水、煲湯，搭配萬物，它是今天年輕人追捧的養生法寶，也是傳承數千年的滋補良藥。春采葉、夏採花、秋采子、冬采根，一株植物全身是寶。它總是以幹皺的形態默默等待，將自己舒展在每一個需要它的時刻，它就是枸杞.

小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第四集: 院子裏種蛇瓜
programme.desc: 兩家人在院子裏種蛇瓜，以省點食物錢。蛇瓜長得快，他們都已經要吃吐了，送給鄰居也不要。林棟哲把瓜帶到學校去，老師同學以為真的是蛇，都被嚇到了。宋瑩罰兒子以後只能吃蛇瓜。莊圖南考上了一中，大家都很高興。莊超英母親摔傷了腿，住進了莊超英家要黃玲和筱婷照顧.

programme.title: 小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第五集: 宋瑩得不到電視機票
programme.desc: 莊母筱婷照顧令到圖南和筱婷晚上沒得好睡。莊圖南為賺一點出卷錢，大冷天也唯有在去刻卷，手都要長凍瘡。今年評先進生產者可以拿到電視機票，結果領導的媳婦拿到了，宋瑩沒有評上，非常生氣。林武峰想好辦法，哄得憤憤不平的宋瑩很高興.

programme.title: 長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第二十三集：李善德回到長安
programme.desc: 李善德去繡坊見到日思夜想的女兒，她抱住李善德的脖頸，一聲一聲阿爹叫個不停。李善德帶着女兒在長安吃飯，回到長安的感覺真好，李善德沉浸在長安的美好之中.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂
programme.desc: 來自秘魯的主廚 Edgar Vigo，並非簡單複製家鄉味，而是憑藉對南美洲飲食的理解，在香港堅守墨西哥菜的正統精髓。Chef Edgar 將會為大家介紹兩款墨西哥經典菜式：朱古力黑醬雞及燉牛面頰，亦會帶 Andy 去淺嚐他喜歡的香港美食，見證他如何將南美的熱情靈魂、香港的生活節奏與墨西哥的傳統，共冶一爐.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 綠能革命
programme.sub-title: 綠能革命: 與時競賽(上)
programme.desc: 從伊爾梅瑙到加州的創新。. 攝製隊前往未來可能成為可再生能源的地點，如北海的離岸風電場和西班牙的太陽能發電場。為了以可持續且經濟的方式滿足能源需求，伊爾梅瑙科技大學的研究人員正與加州理工學院合作，開發高科技材料，提高可再生能源的效率與成本效益。. Innovations from Ilmenau to California. . This documentary explores whether we can provide enough green energy for the entire world, traveling to locations like gigantic offshore wind farms in the North Sea and state-of-the-art solar fields in Spain, which could supply all of Europe with electricity. To meet the rising energy demand sustainably and affordably, researchers at the Ilmenau University of Technology in Thuringia are collaborating with a team from the California Institute of Technology to develop high-tech materials that will make renewable energies more efficient and cheaper than fossil fuels.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: Eva的大仔有自閉症，兩夫婦陪著兒子一直向前行，看著他成為充滿活力、揚帆出海的青年。Wallace創辦組織，舉辦研討會、夏令營、工作坊，聯絡眾多機構為「星星的孩子」提供出路。他感動了魚排老板Alex，令他視照顧自閉人士為人生意義，吸納「星兒」來工作。Kay Rawbone創辦了社企，推動身心殘疾者揚帆出海。. 共融之路從來不易，但一班修路人卻令自閉症人士的世界變得更廣闊。今集主持Marco和Vita會和Wallace傾下計.

programme.sub-title: 第二集：蘇橙橙變身美女蘇渺
programme.desc: 戴着手鐲回家的蘇橙橙，爸媽竟然認不出她，原來她變身成了一個美女。蘇橙橙救下一個小朋友，救人舉動剛巧被唐奇撞見，令他心動不已，還力邀她成為公司化妝品的模特兒。蘇橙橙和好友林媛發現手鐲原來有變身濾鏡的秘密。蘇橙橙的家姐蘇青梨為妹妹在唐奇的公司找到一職位.

programme.title: 冰雪尖刀連
programme.sub-title: 第四集：伍萬里順利成七連新兵
programme.desc: 出發前夜，戰士長喜逃離軍營，被千里詢問後吐露母親重病的苦衷。團長張大彪公開此事，並安排當地政府照顧長喜母親提振士氣。全團緊急出發北上，千里接收特批新兵萬里，得知他攔了師長的車而加入部隊。萬里性格桀驁，引發與認命的衝突，被雷公教訓.

programme.sub-title: 第六集: 莊超英的外甥鵬飛要住進他的家
programme.desc: 莊超英的妹妹是貴州的知青，但不符合回城條件，她的兒子鵬飛要放暑假了，想要到莊超英家裡住。莊超英把人帶回來，黃玲很不高興。黃玲來到婆婆公公家裡，說自己家已有兩個孩子要吃飯，現在糧食不要票，可以花錢買。婆婆想裝傻充愣，黃玲就說等莊超英弟弟回家再商量.

programme.title: 小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第七集: 林棟哲成績突飛猛進
programme.desc: 四個小孩子渡過了一個難忘的暑假。鵬飛就要回去貴州了，鵬飛拿出了一筆錢給黃玲，表示媽媽跟自己說了，自己住在誰家就給誰。黃玲問他怎麼沒跟外婆說，鵬飛表示自己知道阿婆不想收留自己。得到莊超英悉心指導的林棟哲，成績猛進，與莊筱婷一起跳級四年級.

programme.title: 長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第二十四集：左相和盧奐秘密約見
programme.desc: 左相和盧奐秘密約見，為了民生福祉考慮，想要盧奐加快搜集嶺南證據的速度，盡快打擊右相。李善德輾轉了一圈，兜兜轉轉，費盡口舌，被各個衙署推諉，依然遞不出劄子。左藏署的署令推諉了李善德的劄子的事，被返回的李善德聽到.

programme.title: 濾鏡
programme.sub-title: 第三集：蘇橙橙一人分飾兩角
programme.desc: 蘇橙橙化名為蘇渺來到唐奇公司商談，批評了唐奇等合伙人對美麗的定義後便離開了。但唐奇卻更堅定要用蘇渺，知道蘇橙橙認識蘇渺，便請求蘇橙橙幫忙游說蘇渺擔任模特。蘇橙橙無奈替蘇渺答應了唐奇，為同時分演兩人角色，她只能不斷變身切換身分.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 由二人組合''Robynn & Kendy’’身份出道，2020年休團後，葉中月(Robynn)決定獨立發展，創作自己的音樂。以一個人的歌手身份走到第六個年頭，中間推出了不少作品，更發行首張個人大碟、舉行小型音樂會。從合唱到獨唱，從組合到個人，中間經歷過音樂、家庭上身份的轉變，今集就讓Robynn分享當中點滴。. 主持：崔潔彤、黎展峯. 歌曲：. -《小痕跡》. -《自問自答》. -《宇宙煙火》(黎展峯).

programme.title: 31看世界 – 維克托的極限清單2
programme.desc: 在本集，維克托為邁向成為特技演員的夢想，展開了一場充滿風險的冒險。他接受嚴苛訓練，學習電影中的「火人」特技、如占士拜邦般駕駛車輛、從建築物天台一躍而下等等。. 要完成這項挑戰，維克托必須學曉管控風險，更要戰勝內心的恐懼。他成功爭取得機會，走進法國一所世界知名的特技學校受訓，與八十六位同樣懷抱特技演員夢的同窗，一起接受業內頂尖特技導師的培訓。維克托在探索電影特技的奧秘之餘，同時展現出在銀幕背後，用生命與勇氣讓電影綻放魔力的特技人故事。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/法語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2026年4月7日 星期二 晚上10時. . In this episode, Victor embarks on a high‑risk adventure with one goal: to become a film stuntman. He trains to become a human torch, to drive like James Bond, and to jump from a four‑story building. To see the challenge through, Victor must learn to manage risk and, above all, to overcome his fears. . Along the way, he meets some of the industry’s best stunt performers and joins one of the world’s most prestigious stunt schools in France. Together with 86 fellow students who, like him, dream of becoming stunt performers, Victor uncovers the craft’s secrets. This action‑packed, full‑throttle episode dives into the world of those who, behind the scenes, make cinema truly magical. . Bilingual: Cantonese / French (TV version) . Time: (First run) 2026.04.07 Tue, 10pm.

programme.title: 中華知識王2
programme.sub-title: 第二集 - 周吉佩、練美娟、岑珈其 | 漢朝漢服大解構！
programme.desc: 今集歌手周吉佩(吉吉)、主持練美娟(娟娟)和演員岑珈其(珈其)鬥知又鬥智，面對歷史地理、體育、憲法及文學等題目，吉吉和珈其聯手追擊娟娟，娟娟能否突圍而出？影片題帶嘉賓走訪安徽合肥探訪清末重臣李鴻章故居。近年興起漢服熱潮，漢服的箇中細節知識你又認識幾多？增進中華知識，留意《中華知識王2》！. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌陽. 嘉賓：周吉佩、練美娟、岑珈其. #中華知識王#曾卓然#糖妹#阮頌陽#周吉佩#練美娟#岑珈其#安徽合肥#漢朝#漢服#古代服飾.

programme.sub-title: 第五集：北上入朝鮮作戰
programme.desc: 北上途中，萬里因思鄉落淚，千里展示祖國美景並主持入連儀式。萬里正式成為七連一員，但因莽撞被雷公教育。團長宣布北上入朝鮮作戰，五連和七連被任命為尖刀連。面對補給不足，民眾自發送來禦寒物資。臨行前，七連將棉服分給五連，展現連隊情誼.

小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第八集: 莊超英的學生一鳴經營個體戶
programme.desc: 現在鼓勵發展個體經濟，莊超英的舊生一鳴說已經申請了個體戶經營執照，他找宋瑩和黃玲，想要請他們幫忙織毛衣拿去買，更給了五十元定金。鄰居老吳有三個兒女，因家貧不能再供成績好的女兒姍姍上中學上大學，只能去中專。姍姍忍不住哭了起來.

programme.title: 小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第九集: 莊父要莊超英和黃玲離婚
programme.desc: 鄰居王勇的妹妹王芳帶着孩子回來上海當黑戶，兄妹天天在吵。莊超英妹妹也是知青，帶著孩子鵬飛回來，莊超英父母想把鵬飛丟到莊超英家來。黃玲這一次撕破臉了，絕對不會同意鵬飛住過來，莊圖南就要高考了，不能受到影響。莊超英氣得沖出去了，莊父要讓莊超英和黃玲離婚.

programme.title: 長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第二十五集：鄭平安又被趙辛民懷疑
programme.desc: 高州空廊坊的門口，鄭平安因為一把女人的扇子，又被趙辛民懷疑上了。而此時，上林署出事了，貴妃最喜歡的牡丹生了蟲，無人敢治.

programme.title: 傷健同行小僱事
programme.desc: 由宋羅孟君女士（宋太）創辦的喜樂餐飲.教室，多年來為自閉症患者及有特殊需要人士提供工作及培訓機會，每天早上，宋太都會和患有自閉症及輕度智障的女兒Flora一同去「喜樂」開店，其後員工陸續到場，包括在「喜樂」工作多年的，患有中度智能障礙的「大師兄」陸永傑；與媽媽一同上班，雖然患有腦瘤但總是笑容滿面的張鎧晴，以及其他殘疾員工等。. 對宋太來說，這班員工不只是她的工作伙伴，更是情同家人。公司會定期為他們安排各種「課外活動」，員工的照顧者亦會被邀請同遊，令他們都得以享受親子樂。. 作為單親媽媽的宋太，當年因為女兒畢業後找不到工作的經歷，啟發到她為殘疾人士創辦可以安心工作的空間，助力他人的同時亦找到新的人生目標，希望「區區有喜樂」，用自己的每一分力量照亮弱勢社群的人生.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 細味風情
programme.desc: 阿曼憑藉其石油財富，成為現代化的富裕國家，同時又保留許多傳統習俗。這個國家擁有多樣景觀：從沙漠到潟湖，從原始海灘到美麗的山脈。位於阿拉伯半島的阿曼，景象不只有沙漠，更融合了豐富的傳統，多樣的自然風光以及迷人的海洋特色，使其成為中東最神秘的地方之一。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2024年7月16日 星期二晚上10時30分.

programme.title: 大自然深度遊 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 城门郊野公园成立于1977年，是香港其中一个早期设立的郊野公园，范围包括大帽山、草山及针山，内里也有城门水塘、白千层林等景点。. 郊野公园内草木繁盛，有丰富多样的生态值得我们去探索。既可以欣赏到登峰的各种蝴蝶，也可以在大城石涧中找到可爱的淡水鱼。. 不过称霸城门的生物，一定要数山上群居的猴子，仅在城门郊野公园已经有至少四个可见族群。今次由专家教主持远距离观察猴子的生活习惯，并学习和猴子们在山上共存的秘诀.

programme.title: 冰雪尖刀連
programme.sub-title: 第六集：眾人面對酷寒急缺糧食
programme.desc: 七連在高原雪地艱難行軍，面對低落士氣，千里努力鼓勵。萬里對戰爭的現實感到震驚，但對春生的馬產生興趣。途中，遭遇被轟炸的炒麵車，司機臨終前懇求七連帶走糧食。在偵查時，萬里意外撿起反坦克步槍，並遇上美軍搜查小隊，緊張局勢瞬間升級.

小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第十集: 林武峰勸解莊超英
programme.desc: 王勇拿出了刀，把王芳和她女兒趕出去。林武峰來找莊圖南談話，說起了自己以前的事情，母親如何保護他們。安廠長過來找林武峰，想林武峰每個星期去他們廠裡指點一下，可以給他不低的工資。林武峰是有穩定的工作的，不敢冒這個險.

programme.title: 小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第十一集: 莊圖南有色弱影響入大學
programme.desc: 宋瑩家裡買了個電冰箱回來，邀請黃玲一起共用。黃玲說如果莊圖南去上大學了，自己也反對鵬飛過來，就當是林棟哲一樣，多了半個兒子。莊圖南高考完了，考上了同濟大學的建築系，黃玲非常激動。但高考前的體檢結果表示他有輕微色弱，這樣就可能可以讀建築系.

programme.title: 長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第二十六集：李善德求告無門
programme.desc: 李善德求告無門，已經到了絕境，命懸一線，十七娘又逼着還錢。李善德卻沒想到絕處逢生，想要荔枝轉運一事辦得順利穩妥，沒有右相的首肯，再多的批文不過是一堆廢紙。李善德獲知了一些信息，找到了十七娘.

programme.title: 大自然逐樣解4
programme.desc: 《大自然逐樣解4》邀請了嶺南大學科學教研部助理教授劉彥芹博士及研究助理邱思敏，分享有關淡水生態及外來螯蝦的生態知識。本集以紅鰲螯蝦、克氏螯蝦和橫紋南鰍作例子，並利用XR擴增實境技術，以全面生態視野去探索外來螯蝦和淡水魚類的外貌特徵、生活習性、以及生存智慧.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 尋色中國
programme.desc: 聚焦鄉土生活中的傳統色彩，以民間節慶、手工藝為載體展現鮮活色譜。通過藍印花布、年畫等非遺技藝，記錄草木染料的自然萃取與染色工藝，呈現色彩在農耕文明中的生動實踐.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 尋色中國
programme.desc: 聚焦中國色彩文化中的特殊存在。通過探尋罕見圖騰、神秘礦物顏料，如青金石、雌黃，及少數民族獨特色譜，揭秘色彩在信仰與藝術中的深層意象。鏡頭深入西藏唐卡工坊、雲南紮染村落，展現工匠如何將自然與人文凝結為非凡色彩.

programme.title: 中華知識王2
programme.sub-title: 第二集 - 周吉佩、練美娟、岑珈其 | 漢朝漢服大解構！
programme.desc: 今集歌手周吉佩(吉吉)、主持練美娟(娟娟)和演員岑珈其(珈其)鬥知又鬥智，面對歷史地理、體育、憲法及文學等題目，吉吉和珈其聯手追擊娟娟，娟娟能否突圍而出？影片題帶嘉賓走訪安徽合肥探訪清末重臣李鴻章故居。近年興起漢服熱潮，漢服的箇中細節知識你又認識幾多？增進中華知識，留意《中華知識王2》！. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌陽. 嘉賓：周吉佩、練美娟、岑珈其. #中華知識王#曾卓然#糖妹#阮頌陽#周吉佩#練美娟#岑珈其#安徽合肥#漢朝#漢服#古代服飾.

programme.title: 傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: Founded by Mrs. Song, Holy Cafe has, for many years, provided job and training opportunities for people with special needs. Every morning, Mrs. Song starts her work together with her daughter Flora, who has autism and mild intellectual disability. Soon after, the rest of the staff arrive — among them, “Big Brother” Luk Wing-kit, who has moderate intellectual disability and has worked at Holy Cafe for many years; Cheung Hoi-ching, who always greets others with a smile despite living with a brain tumor; and several other employees with disabilities. . To Mrs. Song, these workers are more than staff — they are family. The company regularly organizes outings and recreational activities, inviting caregivers to join so that everyone can enjoy meaningful parent-child moments together. . As a single mother, Mrs. Song was inspired to start this social enterprise after struggling to find a job for her daughter after graduation. She created a safe and caring workplace for people with disabilities while also discovering a renewed sense of purpose. Her vision is for Holy Cafe to bring happiness to every community — to use her strength to brighten the lives of those who are often overlooked. . In this episode, our host Jason Chan joins the Holy Cafe team to take on an “impossible mission.” Will they manage to complete the challenge and surprise Mrs. Song and the caregivers with an unexpected joy.

香港故事:尾巴會說話(英文版)
醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康
programme.sub-title: #5 Tomatoes: A Godsend for the Complexion
programme.desc: Tomatoes have high nutritional value and are rich in antioxidants and Vitamin C. They also contain much lycopene that facilitates the growth and regeneration of skin cells, making them a natural skincare. This episode of “Eat Well Live Well” features tomatoes, and the two “Food Fanatic” will visit a local farm for a deep understanding on the agricultural process of tomatoes and a taste of different varieties of tomatoes. . When it comes to tomato dishes, tomato and potato soup must be no strangers to Hong Kong people. In this episode, Chef Will will prepare a fusion soup in Western-style to put a new spin on the dish; and Dr CHAN Hau-ngai, Specialist in Dermatology, and artiste Snow SUEN are invited to enjoy the delicacy together. Dr CHAN will also answer questions and explain why tomatoes are beneficial to our skin. Even Snow has become a mother of two, she still looks glamorous. She will share with audience her tips about diet and skincare. . Hosts: Snowy CHOI, Will LEUNG (Chef). Guests: Snow SUEN, Dr CHAN Hau-ngai (Specialist in Dermatology).

programme.title: 香港奇則 2
programme.desc: 住公屋、住居居都可以有私樓感覺！ 提起香港公屋居屋的則，雖然後者都屬於私人擁有，但單位開則和間隔都大同小異，尤其一些樓齡較高的單位，廚廁細多喉管等等問題。 過往，公屋居屋的裝修都實用為主，近年，不少屋主都願意付出金錢，加上裝修建築物料多元化，設計師只.

programme.title: 台灣絕美餐廳
programme.desc: 宜蘭礁溪的露營咖啡館，座落在孔雀山上，遠眺蘭陽平原，吃在地桶仔雞，一日遊或是過夜露營，通通都可以！還去太平山一家於深山的披薩餐廳，老闆遠赴意大利學習，成為登山客最愛的美食之一。接著到台北烏來，拜訪瀑布前的玻璃屋，從日據老宅變身為最受歡迎的絕美餐廳。.

programme.title: 食過Find尋味
programme.desc: 第五集又到Yanny帶大家尋找小清新風味，去到將軍澳海濱附近一間附設健身室嘅餐廳，除左食風景，更會品嚐創意素肉餐單，又介紹Arthur食女士最愛嘅甜點蛋糕。今次Arthur炮製輕食，夏威夷poke bowl，將簡單三文魚、吞拿魚、牡丹蝦配以牛油果，做.

programme.title: 真深好玩
programme.desc: 第四集繼續有孫慧雪帶路到深圳玩，今次集中華強北附近，一間老北京裝修風格集團京菜館，以大檯聚餐客人為主，靠「北京烤鴨」聞名，之後雪雪首次踏足「男人天堂」，走入「龍勝配件城」盡情掃貨，以批發價出售各類手機電子配件，就算零售一樣搵到寶。最後，雪雪感受大排檔.

programme.title: 午間新聞
programme.desc: (直播).

programme.title: 日式流行
programme.desc: 想感受東京最 chill、最慢活嘅一面？清澄白河呢度充滿文青氣息，手作雜貨、咖啡香一路伴住你散步。連平時喺實驗室先會見到嘅玻璃器皿，都可以變成屋企嘅藝術品或花器，行到每一間店都好似走進小型展覽咁，舒服又好拍。跟住嚟到千代田嘅學區，邊個會諗到，一扇好唔.

programme.title: 健康關注組
programme.desc: 假期時間長，家長最擔心小朋友玩得太多，變得心散，再難以專注學習。當學童更多時間留在家中，家長可以用甚麼簡單活動或遊戲，訓練孩子專注力，與及說話和聆聽能力呢？平日家長可能嚴格管制子女使用電子產品，但在假期也不得不稍為放寬，怎樣利用電子產品，提升子女的能.

programme.title: 坐月攻略
programme.desc: 今集主持阿雪邀請了即將為人母的可宜參觀月子酒店，這間酒店式公寓，房租堪稱全港最貴，媽媽入住的可說是最奢華的坐月享受。期間，阿雪亦向可宜分享不少坐月心得⋯⋯另外，媽媽級大廚Carlina會示範煮素食月子餐。.

programme.title: 超甲蟲戰記 聖域傳說
香港奇則 2
programme.desc: 近十年不少工廈單位經過活化後，單位用途都變得多樣化，單位業主亦願意花心思將其粉飾一番。經營酒類生意的公司，單位除了存貨及辦公，亦要見客試酒，設計師如何將平平無奇的工廈單位，重新劃分成不同用途同時，又要展現到企業形象？ 設計師的工作室兼Show.

programme.desc: 呢一集真係滿滿童趣感！主持第一站就去咗一間「行入去以為走錯路」嘅麵包店——外表係麵包店，但入面竟然係被玩具淹沒嘅復古美式世界！成間店都係七、八十年代嘅經典玩具，每個角落都好打卡，影完相再食埋個出爐麵包，開場已經好開心！之後來到一個超出乎意料嘅景點，錢.
